### Planewalker’s Path

Your fighting style is influenced by your connection to the planes.

**Powers:** dimension swap, inertial armor.

**Skills:** Acrobatics, Autohypnosis, Perception.

**Bonus Class Skill:** Knowledge (the planes).

**Trance:** Beginning at 3rd level, while maintaining psionic focus, you gain a +1 competence bonus on attack and damage rolls made against any outsiders or opponents with the extraplanar subtype. This bonus increases by 1 every four psychic warrior levels thereafter.

**Maneuver:** Beginning at 3rd level, any time you strike an outsider or enemy that has the extraplanar subtype with a melee attack you can expend your psionic focus to deal an additional +2d6 damage. For every five psychic warrior levels you gain thereafter, this damage increases by +1d6.
